001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * The pump's response to a SetTempRateRequest, written immediately after the
009 * {@link ControlRequestHistoryLog} for that request (request opcode 164). When the temp rate is
010 * accepted, the {@link TempRateActivatedHistoryLog} it started comes two records earlier.
011 *
012 * <p>The class name is provisional: Tandem's cloud export and the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum
013 * do not name this opcode. Only seen on the Mobi, where the phone can set temp rates.
014 *
015 * <p>In Trio/TandemKit logs the three fields equalled the status, byte 3 and tempRateId of the
016 * logged SetTempRateResponse in every record that had one (1738/1738 and 614/614 on two Mobi
017 * pumps). Across all captures, status 0 records carried the tempRateId of the TempRateActivated
018 * written two records earlier in 2751/2751 cases; the 7 status 1 records had tempRateId 0, byte
019 * 11 set to 1 and no TempRateActivated. Bytes 14-25 were zero in all 2758 records. See
020 * https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/145.
021 */
022@HistoryLogProps(
023    opCode = 309,
024    displayName = "Set Temp Rate Response",
025    internalName = ""
026)
027public class SetTempRateResponseHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
028
029    private int status;
030    private int unknown11;
031    private int tempRateId;
032
033    public SetTempRateResponseHistoryLog() {}
034    public SetTempRateResponseHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int status, int unknown11, int tempRateId) {
035        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
036        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, status, unknown11, tempRateId);
037        this.status = status;
038        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
039        this.tempRateId = tempRateId;
040    }
041
042    public SetTempRateResponseHistoryLog(int status, int unknown11, int tempRateId) {
043        this(0, 0, status, unknown11, tempRateId);
044    }
045
046    public int typeId() {
047        return 309;
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * <table border="1">
052     * <caption>Parsed fields for SetTempRateResponseHistoryLog:</caption>
053     * <tr><td><code>status</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>tempRateId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
056     * </table>
057     */
058    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
059        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
060        this.cargo = raw;
061        parseBase(raw);
062        this.status = raw[10] & 0xFF;
063        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
064        this.tempRateId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
065    }
066
067    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int status, int unknown11, int tempRateId) {
068        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
069            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(309, 0),
070            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
071            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
072            new byte[]{ (byte) status, (byte) unknown11 },
073            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(tempRateId)));
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * @return the SetTempRateResponse status: 0 when the temp rate was started, 1 when it was
078     *         rejected
079     */
080    public int getStatus() {
081        return status;
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * Byte 3 of the SetTempRateResponse cargo, which pumpX2 does not parse. It was 0 whenever
086     * the status was 0 and 1 in all 7 rejected requests observed; its meaning is unknown.
087     *
088     * @return byte 11
089     */
090    public int getUnknown11() {
091        return unknown11;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * @return the id of the temp rate that was started (see
096     *         {@link TempRateActivatedHistoryLog#getTempRateId()}), or 0 when the request was
097     *         rejected
098     */
099    public int getTempRateId() {
100        return tempRateId;
101    }
102}
